enchantments.tooltip: +6 Enhancement Bonus: +6 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.
Vitality +20: Passive: +20 Vitality bonus to Hit Points.
Fire Resistance +40: Passive: +40 Enhancement bonus to your Fire Resistance.
Fire Absorption +20%: Passive: 20% Enhancement Bonus to Fire Absorption. (Absorption reduces damage from an element by a percentage, after resistance have been taken into account.)
Protection +6: Passive: +6 Deflection bonus to Armor Class.

Fortification +100%: This suit of armor or shield produces a magical force that protects vital areas of the wearer much more effectively. When a critical hit or sneak attack is scored on the wearer, there is a 100% chance that the critical hit or sneak attack is negated and damage is instead rolled normally.
Seeker +10: Provides a +10 Enhancement bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +10 Enhancement bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).
